dial.summary: BTC Accumulation conditions hold on August 26 as PCE and GDP 2nd estimate release today: BTC ~$79K, BTC.D firm at ~59%, funding rates near zero, global M2 expanding (US M2 $23.22T for July, record high); real yields remain headwind at 2.38% but off 4-week high of 2.43%; DXY at 99.07 (neutral band, 4-week down); 2s10s at +47bps steepening; today's PCE print (exp. 3.6% headline) and Warsh's inaugural Jackson Hole keynote August 28 are the decisive macro gate for the next leg.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: Global 4-bank M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) at ~$102.7T (latest available, ~6-week reporting lag); US M2 for July 2026 released August 25 at $23,218B ($23.22T), up from $23,155B in June—29th consecutive monthly increase, +6.11% YoY, record high; no YoY contraction signal from any major central bank; 4-week uptrend confirmed; status supportive.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: July 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.6% (released August 3) remains the most recent reading—August 2026 data releases September 1; sub-indexes: New Orders 56.7%, Production 58.5%, Employment 52.8%, Prices Paid 71.1%; highest reading since May 2022; 4-week trend up (June 53.3% → July 55.6%, +2.3pp); status supportive (above 50 and rising; headwind thresholds of <48 falling or >62 not met).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY at 99.07 on August 26, 2026 (+0.11% on the day); 4-week trend down: DXY weakened ~2.4% over the past month (from ~101.5 around July 26 to 99.07 on August 26), well above the 0.5% flat threshold; structural dollar weakness driven by US Treasury expanded long-term buyback program and rate cut expectations; status neutral (ICE DXY in the 97.5–100 neutral band; today's PCE print and Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote August 28 are key directional catalysts; a sustained close below 97.5 would flip to supportive).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: FRED DFII10 at 2.38% as of August 24, 2026 (August 26 release pending intraday); 4-week trend down: ~2.43% (July 25) → 2.38% (August 24) = -5bps, at the 5bps flat threshold; status headwind (above the 2% absolute threshold despite the falling trend; soft PCE today and a dovish Warsh keynote August 28 are the catalysts needed to compress real yields meaningfully below 2%).

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: August 26, 2026: 10Y yield at ~4.70%, 2Y yield at ~4.23%; spread = +47bps; 4-week trend up: ~+35bps (July 24) → +47bps (August 26) = +12bps steepening, above the 5bps flat threshold; status supportive (positive spread AND sustained 4-week steepening trend intact; today's PCE and Warsh tone August 28 are the next key curve inputs).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL: $6,745,699M (~$6.75T) for week ending August 19, 2026 (H.4.1 released August 20; next release August 27); 4-week trend flat: ~$6.70T (August 5) → $6.75T (August 19) = +$50B (+0.7%), near the 0.5% flat threshold; balance sheet holding at post-2022 stabilization plateau with no aggressive QT signal; status supportive.

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC perpetual funding rate held near zero across major exchanges (Binance, Bybit, OKX) through August 25, 2026; BTC price ~$79,038 on August 25 (up from ~$77,716 on August 24); funding remained flat-to-near-zero despite price appreciation—a textbook accumulation signature (price up, funding flat); well below the +0.04%/8h overheating headwind threshold; 30-day trend down vs late-June/early-July elevated levels; status supportive. (Specific today's rate unavailable—CoinGlass unreachable via proxy; value held from prior run.)

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$305B (late August 2026, CoinGecko); total crypto market cap ~$2.76T; stablecoin dominance at 11.06% (down from 11.35% on August 25, 2026); BTC.D ~58–59% (firm above 55%); 30-day trend down: ~13–14% (July 26) → 11.06% (August 26)—capital rotating from stablecoins into risk assets; status supportive (30-day falling trend confirmed; headwind condition—dominance rising while TOTAL rises—is opposite of current dynamics).

upcoming.title: Jackson Hole Economic Symposium Opens (August 27–29)
upcoming.note: Kansas City Fed annual Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium begins at Jackson Lake Lodge, Wyoming—runs August 27–29; by the time proceedings open, markets will have processed PCE and GDP 2nd estimate (August 26); Warsh delivers his inaugural keynote Friday morning August 28; FOMC September 15–16 is the next binding commitment.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended August 22, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for week ending August 22—released the opening morning of Jackson Hole; a sustained rise in claims arriving as the symposium opens would immediately shape the tone for Warsh's inaugural keynote the next morning (August 28); context: July NFP shocked at −23K, making weekly claims particularly closely watched.

upcoming.title: Fed Chair Warsh Inaugural Jackson Hole Keynote
upcoming.note: Kevin Warsh delivers his inaugural Jackson Hole address Friday morning August 28—the single most important macro event of this cycle for the crypto risk framework; all macro inputs will be in hand by then (PCE Aug 26, GDP 2nd estimate Aug 26, Jobless Claims Aug 27); real yields at 2.38% with 4-week downtrend; DXY at 99.07 (neutral band); a hawkish tone would sharply pressure risk assets; a neutral or dovish tone alongside soft PCE would be the macro green light to extend BTC's rally toward new all-time highs; September 15–16 FOMC is the next binding commitment.

upcoming.title: Chicago PMI (August 2026)
upcoming.note: Chicago Business Barometer for August 2026 at 9:45 AM ET—released the last business day of August (Monday August 31); regional manufacturing cross-check against the July ISM surge (55.6%); a reading above 50 reinforces broad manufacturing expansion heading into the September 1 ISM release and pre-FOMC September 15–16 positioning.

upcoming.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (August 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases the August 2026 Manufacturing PMI Report on Business at 10:00 AM ET—first post-Jackson Hole activity read; July 2026 ISM came in at 55.6% (highest since May 2022); a sustained expansion above 50 reinforces risk asset positioning; a collapse below 50 alongside a hawkish Warsh tone would pressure a Risk Off reassessment; pre-FOMC September 15–16 positioning begins in earnest.

upcoming.title: ADP National Employment Report (August 2026)
upcoming.note: ADP releases the August 2026 National Employment Report at 8:15 AM ET—private sector employment proxy arriving two days before the official NFP report (September 4); July ADP showed +44,000 private-sector jobs added; a weak reading would reinforce July NFP shock (−23K) and bolster the rate-cut case heading into FOMC September 15–16; a strong rebound toward +100K+ would complicate the dovish narrative.
